meta.title: Services — NestSelf
meta.description: Therapy and counselling, legal consultation and financial guidance — all in one employee wellbeing programme.

hero.title: Support that covers what matters
hero.lead: Three areas of professional help — psychological, legal and financial — available to employees and, where your employer's plan includes family members, their families.

pillars.title: Therapy & Counselling
paragraphs: Talk to licensed psychologists and qualified psychotherapists about stress, anxiety, relationships, grief or anything else on your mind.
Sessions are available online or in person where offered, in Serbian, Hungarian or English.

photo.alt: A person talking to a psychologist during an in-person session

pillars.title: Legal Consultation
paragraphs: Get confidential guidance on personal legal matters — employment contracts, tenancy, family law basics, consumer issues and more.
A qualified legal professional reviews your situation and provides a written summary of next steps.

photo.alt: A legal consultation session at a desk

pillars.title: Financial Guidance
paragraphs: Work with an independent financial consultant on budgeting, debt, savings, loans or retirement planning.
Our consultants sell no products and receive no commissions — their advice is entirely in your interest.

photo.alt: A person reviewing financial plans with a consultant

items.title: Choose the area
items.body: Pick psychological, legal or financial support — whichever fits your situation.

items.title: Pick a professional and a time
items.body: Browse available professionals and select a time that works. Sessions are available by video or in person where offered.

items.title: See your coverage
items.body: Your coverage and any cost are shown before you confirm. No surprises.

items.title: Talk
items.body: Meet your professional for a confidential session. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed.

items.title: Follow up
items.body: Follow-ups and session notes stay with you. Book another session whenever you need one.

items.question: Is this covered by my employer?
items.answer: Your employer pays for the programme. Before you confirm a session, the platform shows your coverage and any remaining cost so there are no surprises.

items.question: Will my employer know I used the service?
items.answer: No. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed. HR sees only anonymised usage data for groups of 10 or more.

items.question: Can my family use NestSelf?
items.answer: Where your employer's plan includes family members, your partner and children can access the same services at no extra cost.

items.question: What languages are sessions available in?
items.answer: Sessions are available in Serbian, Hungarian and English, depending on the professional.

items.question: Can I choose between video and in-person sessions?
items.answer: Yes. When you pick a professional and time, you will see whether video, in-person or both options are available.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Your employer provides access details when the programme launches. You create a private account, choose a service area and book your first session.
